rust_summary: every slot of the acting player's inventory, read and replaced whole by vanilla's numbering (`native_slot_stack`, `native_set_slot_stack`), and the selected hotbar slot (`native_selected_slot`).
doc_summary: `native_slot_stack(slot)` is the stack in the acting player's inventory slot `slot` with all its data, numbered as `Inventory.getItem` (0 to 8 the hotbar, 9 to 35 the rest, 36 to 39 the armour from the feet up, 40 the off hand; on a client, the player's own); `native_set_slot_stack(slot, stack)` puts a stack there as `Inventory.setItem`, None or a count of 0 emptying it (false past 40 and on a client of a server); `native_selected_slot()` is the hotbar slot the main hand holds. Bundles need "hooks": @API:slot_stack@.
